findings.finding: Silverback Capital's Section 3(a)(10) settlement (a $10.7m claim paid in tranches of free-trading shares at fixed prices) was reinstated on 2026-05-18 and is still a running source of supply that can sell into any bounce on 10-06.
findings.mechanism_in_window: This is a continuous seller, not a dated event. Tranches can be issued and sold on any session including 10-06, and the August written consent sought 20% approval specifically for issuance to Silverback.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 6,866,000 pre-split shares were issued under the settlement before the April termination (search snippet of the FY2025 10-K and 8-K). That was during the period the stock fell to a 1-for-50 reverse split on 2026-05-26. No per-day reaction can be attributed to it.
findings.why_not_priced: The remaining claim amount is not disclosed in the 10-Q, so the size of the supply cannot be seen. The PRE 14C has not gone definitive (no DEF 14C on EDGAR), so the 20% approval may not be effective yet and the cap may be limiting Silverback. That uncertainty is why this is small.
findings.independence: The 10-Q (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0002030763/000149315226038581/form10-q.htm) confirms Silverback issuances through April and May 2026 and a going-concern doubt.

findings.finding: Short interest rose 147.5% to 430,628 shares (about 14% of shares outstanding, more of the float) at the 2026-09-15 settlement, against a name whose last three falls of 10% or more were followed by next-session moves of +11.2%, +22.5% and +28.1%.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Covering by a short base that the run-up built; at 1.0 days to cover it can cover inside one session. Not dated. This is a positioning fact whose effect can show up on 10-06 but is not scheduled to.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline events: after the 09-18 fall, next close +11.17%; after 09-25, +22.51%; after 09-30, +28.08%; after 10-02, -6.80%. Up rate across all 144 comparable falls was 37.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The figure is lagged and stale. Whether shorts pressed into today's fall or had already covered cannot be seen, so this finding is capped small.
findings.independence: A Sept 29 headline on the 147.5% rise in short interest (defenseworld.net, via https://www.optionsanalysissuite.com/stocks/meds/news). It re-reports the same FINRA data, so it is not independent.

findings.finding: The issuer releases promotional news every two to three business days (Sep 15, 21, 25, 28; Oct 1, 5), so another release inside the 10-06 session is likely, and the 09-28 app launch release coincided with a reported share surge.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Inferred from cadence. The company has not announced anything for 10-06; the six releases from Sep 15 to Oct 5 put the chance of one on any session at about 40-50%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 09-28: shares surged on the Health Lives Here app launch (Benzinga headline). 10-01: the Corexa release on more than $1m in monthly revenue came the day before a -9.4% fall on 10-02. Mixed.
findings.why_not_priced: A release that has not happened yet cannot be in the close. This is a cadence prior, not evidence a release exists, so it is sized small.
